# Base Data Release Notes

Changes to the contents and organization of base_data — new datasets, promotions from `submissions/`, and format migrations — are recorded here. Each release of the store at <https://data.teemlabs.org> is listed in its `_release/` folder; notable ones are summarised below.

## 2026-10-30

- Release `2026.10.30.1`: the **OpenStreetMap extracts** collection, `osm/`, 132 files for two regions, Rwanda (`osm/rwa/`, 1.6 GB) and Saint Paul, Minnesota (`osm/saint_paul_mn/`, 359 MB). Per region: the region polygon, 47 themed GeoPackages (`theme_vectors/`), ten merged single-geometry products (`product_vectors/`) and eight presence, distance and density POGs at 10 arcseconds (`derived_rasters/`). Cut from the openplanetdata.com planet GeoParquet (build 2026-10-27) by `linneabean.osm`; the run file is `osm/osm_base_data_ingestion.py`, one scenario row per region, and a region not in the ee_r264 set is defined by an OSM boundary query. ODbL-1.0.
- Releases `2026.10.22.2`, `2026.10.23.1` and `2026.10.23.2`: the `cartographic/ee` zone-id POGs (`ee_r264_ids.tif`, `eemarine_r566_ids.tif`) and the correspondence geopackages and tables; vectors (`.gpkg`) and tables (`.csv`, `.xlsx`) became publishable kinds on 2026-10-23.

## 2026-10-20

- Release `2026.10.20.1`: the ESA CCI / C3S annual land-cover maps, `lulc/esa/lulc_esa_1992.tif` to `lulc_esa_2022.tif`, as categorical POGs (31 datasets).
- Browsable pages at <https://data.teemlabs.org>, rebuilt after every publish.
- The submissions inbox moves to `base_data_submissions/` beside `base_data/` on the NatCapTEEMs shared drive; the old `base_data/submissions/` folder is retired. [Contributing Base Data](contributing_base_data.qmd) is rewritten for submitting, promoting and publishing.

## 2026-10-19

- Release `2026.10.19.1`, the first in the canonical store on Cloudflare R2: the 17 `pyramids/ha_per_cell_<rung>sec.tif` POGs, 10 arcseconds to 180 degrees, under CC-BY-4.0.

## 2026-09-01

- Initial base_data documentation published: the [overview](base_data/index.qmd), the [contributing workflow](contributing_base_data.qmd), and the [POG specification](pogs.qmd).
